# Town of Peacham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 1 -- Tim McKay was re-elected Moderator for the ensuing year; he announced it is his fifteenth and final year
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Peacham's warning elects the clerk to a three-year term
Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 11 -- Rebecca Washington was re-elected Town Clerk for a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rebecca Washington as Peacham's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Peacham's warning elects one officer as 'Town Treasurer and Tax Collector'

Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 12 -- Rebecca Washington was re-elected Town Treasurer and Tax Collector for a three-year term. Peacham elects the treasurer and the tax collector as one combined office; it is modeled as this single treasurer post, and Peacham's separately warned Delinquent Tax Collector (Article 20, a one-year office) is a distinct post
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rebecca Washington as Peacham's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Peacham's five selectboard members: Alfred Dedam (Chair), Will Kempton, Andrea Otto, Christina Rumery, and Christian Snow

Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 13 -- Andrea Otto was elected to a three-year term (she had been filling a vacancy; Peter Craig departed); Article 14 -- Christian Snow was re-elected to a two-year term; Article 15 -- Christina Rumery was elected to a one-year term completing a vacated term
Town of Peacham, Selectboard page (peachamvt.org): lists the same five members

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three on staggered three-year terms

Town of Peacham, 2025 Town Report (posted on the town's town reports page): the town officers table lists listers Nathan Colpitts, Clarissa Kendall (term to 2027), and Jean Dedam (term to 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three auditors on staggered three-year terms
Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 17 -- Jill Hurst was elected Auditor for a three-year term
Town of Peacham, 2025 Town Report (posted on the town's town reports page): the town officers table lists auditors Jill Hurst, Charlotte Mooney (term to 2027), and Robert Starbuck (term to 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable
Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 18 -- John Sheehan was re-elected First Constable for a one-year term
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns may elect a second constable; Peacham's warning elects one
Town of Peacham, Town Meeting Minutes, March 3, 2026 (signed; peachamvt.org): Article 19 -- Nate Giroux was re-elected Second Constable for a one-year term
